title: Hearing on syringe litter cleanup and needle buyback program
summary: The Council's Committee on Mental Health & Substance Use is holding an oversight hearing on syringe litter management and the city's Community Syringe Redemption Program, which pays participants 20 cents per syringe up to $10 a day at eight sites citywide. The hearing will also examine related bills, including one requiring a public education campaign on fentanyl test strips and two resolutions urging state and federal governments to require addiction treatment training in medical schools. Officials report the program collected over 2.3 million syringes and paid about $292,000 to participants in its first 16 months, with $3 million allocated for fiscal year 2027.
